title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 5 · Storeroom

sourceRecords.title: Area 5 · Storeroom and Sildar’s gear
read: Spoiled provisions and old casks crowd the room. Among them lie a bloodied coat of mail, a crossbow, and a sword bearing a familiar crest.

The recognizable equipment is within a room still crowded by old stores. You can examine its markings and condition without deciding how it came here. The casks and provisions break up the floor around it, so someone can watch the entrance while another person investigates.

brief: Castle storeroom: old casks of salted meat, sacks of rotten grain, ordinary closed small brandy cask. Bloody/rust-stained chainmail, heavy crossbow and unsheathed longsword with small Neverwinter emblem among supplies, no graphic gore. No owner magically named, opened treasure or fresh banquet. Dim natural slit light.
